item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
Surge Browser 1.3.0

A big update to the browser you own: the latest security fixes, a new sign-in built right into Surge, and more control over your equity and your data.

  • Up to date, and on every Mac. Surge now runs on the newest browser engine, with months of security and speed improvements, and it runs natively on Intel Macs as well as Apple silicon.
  • Sign in right in Surge. Signing in now happens inside the browser. Each member on your Mac gets their own profile, with your photo on it, and Guest mode is there when you want to browse privately.
  • Your equity, your control. Lock surge://equity behind Touch ID or your Mac password, delete individual clicks from your ledger, or delete your account from Settings.
  • Movies and shows play. Streaming services such as YouTube, HBO Max and Disney+ now play protected video.
